entry.title: Stonehenge
entry.note: English Heritage2015 current-site plan pixels and its25m scale/north arrow were actually inspected, separately from its ancient-phase reconstructions. Four fresh attributed OSM stone outlines identify Heel96, Slaughter95, Station91 and Station93 (way/133262440, way/133262443, way/377365047, way/377367000). Their centers rigidly fit the authored positions without scale change: anchor[-1.8262310128,51.1788579596],heading0.013739514043rad,maximum1.127m residual. Native+X points almost east and+Z almost south; the Heel Stone is east and north of the ring, resolving the sign. Whole earthwork identity is way37118074 Q39671 and is not used to stretch the32m stone ring into a120m building. Five-meter/two-degree registration is an accepted reconstruction, not a survey. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
